normalization_rules: do not treat DETER Cerrado as a proxy for PRODES Cerrado
do not treat alert area as a monthly or annual deforestation rate
do not assign the image acquisition date as the exact event date
do not compare consecutive months or the same month across years without accounting for image availability
when comparison is necessary, preserve the method guidance to compare the same interval of at least three months across years with caution
preserve 55–64 m as nominal sensor resolution range and do not convert it into mapping scale or minimum mapped polygon size
preserve three hectares as the method's minimum detectable alert area and not as a guarantee of complete detection
preserve 1:100,000 as manual digitization scale and not as raster resolution
preserve 48–72 hours as typical end-to-end latency and not as a universal SLA
preserve daily nightly public updates as validated previous-day publication, distinct from controlled real-time enforcement access
preserve monthly consolidation as aggregation after month end, not as monthly rate
preserve the operational legend through its dedicated contract and do not map sensor-specific operational classes automatically to metadata or validation classes
preserve validation process as documented while accuracy values, confusion matrix and validation classes remain unresolved
preserve 2018 and 2019 as different documented timeline events instead of selecting one year silently
preserve the Landsat-or-similar metadata statement and the WFI/AWFI method statement as source-dated contexts
the 2024 method document resolves a method edition but does not resolve the current product release or current asset
do not infer current layer, endpoint, schema, bytes, license or citation from the method document
promotion remains blocked until release identity, current operational linkage, quality metrics where available, distribution and asset evidence are sufficient
